exposures.name: Thomas + rotation
exposures.description:
Thomas (aka Cnp) at 3ms pd/cd, with 500ms sequencer steps [1,2,3,1+2+3]. Based on the exposure described in:

Buckner CA, Buckner AL, Koren SA, Persinger MA, Lafrenie RM (2015) Inhibition of Cancer Cell Growth by Exposure to a Specific Time-Varying Electromagnetic Field Involves T-Type Calcium Channels. PLoS ONE 10(4): e0124136. https://doi.org/10.1371/journal.pone.0124136

profile.name: Unsigned 8-bit DAC
profile.description: Line-oriented text DAC: the first line is the point count and each following line is one decimal 8-bit sample value (0..255).

metadata.notes:
Thomas DAC pattern (aka Cnp) at 3ms point delay and 3ms cycle delay. Uses 4.08V as the 5V equivalent - to compensate for the voltage drop across the optocoupler (MOC3010) in the real-world signal path.

Original DAC points provided by Dr. Persinger circa 2008.

First described as the 'Cnp' in:

Thomas AW, Kavaliers M, Prato FS, Ossenkopp KP. Analgesic effects of a specific pulsed magnetic field in the land snail, Cepaea nemoralis: consequences of repeated exposures, relations to tolerance and cross-tolerance with DPDPE. Peptides. 1998;19(2):333-42. doi: 10.1016/s0196-9781(97)00380-x. PMID: 9493866.
